environment.scope: Recorded agent-context replay through native Gemma4Model.chatSessionStart and llama.cpp /completion; high thinking, historical tool results, greedy AR without speculation; cold prompt cache.
environment.mlxCachePolicy: Session API requires reuseCache=true; resetCaches() immediately before every measured request; assert cachedTokens == 0.
environment.kvCache: BF16 in both runtimes; MLX paged cache, llama.cpp standard KV cache.
environment.prefillBatching: MLX_PAGED_PREFILL_CHUNK_SIZE=512; llama.cpp logical batch 2048, physical ubatch 512.
environment.loadTiming: Excluded: both use an existing disk artifact and a fresh process; main GGUF plus prepared MLX cache already page-cache warm. MLX also loads the media companion, while this text-only llama server does not.
environment.workstation: Interactive desktop session. No other inference benchmark was running. Normal desktop applications remain active.
environment.warmup: 32 generated tokens using the first real diff-review fixture before every sample, followed by a full cache reset.
environment.inputPolicy: Whole recorded turn boundaries. No synthetic input. Actual generated token count is retained if the model stops before the cap.
environment.sourcePatchIncludes: Tracked changes and every new source file under crates/, packages/, and __test__/.
